To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) we propose a semi supervised learning approach, referred to as select net, to learn to select and add unlabelled "in the wild'' data to the training data to mitigate class imbalance, 2) the select net approach outperforms the state of the art techniques in dealing with class imbalance, 3) the select net framework can be extended to other semi supervised learning problems.
SelectNet, a deep neural network that learns to selectively sample from unlabelled data, can be used to train a classifier to deal with class imbalanced data.

1) SelectNet, a semi supervised learning approach that selectively adds unlabelled data to the training dataset, is effective in learning from training data of imbalanced class sizes; 2) SelectNet outperforms existing approaches in learning from training datasets with imbalanced class size, and achieves comparable performance to the best performing methods on balanced class size datasets.

the design of deep learning models that can be trained with unbalanced training data.

SelectNet provides a simple and effective solution for learning to sample from the wild for imbalanced data training.
our approach, SelectNet, is a general and effective method for learning from imbalanced training data.

SelectNet is an end to end learning framework that is capable of learning from the unlabelled "in the wild", and is able to significantly improve the classification accuracy of the classifier on the test set.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we provide a new perspective to tackle the challenge of learning with imbalanced data by learning to select from unlabelled data, and our approach can be easily incorporated into existing supervised learning frameworks.
, by training a deep network to learn to select and label unlabelled data, we have developed a new paradigm that can be used as a general framework for learning from imbalanced data.
SelectNet provides a simple and effective approach to learning from unlabelled data in a semi supervised manner, thus significantly alleviates the difficulty in dealing class imbalanced data.
The main takeaway from our work is that

, with proper training of SelectNet, it is able to learn to sample the most informative unlabelled data from the wild, and the resulting classifier trained on the selected data is able to achieve state of the art accuracy on the standard benchmarks.
, by selectively adding unlabelled data to the training set, SelectNet can significantly improve the performance on imbalanced data training.

SelectNet can be used to train deep neural networks for imbalanced data training, without requiring the use of any class specific information such as the cost of each class, the margin between classes, etc.
